candidates.author: Eric W. Dolan
candidates.summary: Researchers have documented 626 homicides committed under the influence of psychedelics since 1962. Delusions appeared in about 28 percent of cases, and offenders who had them were far more likely to kill a partner, friend, or parent.

candidates.title: Family ties emerge as a key link between poverty and teen well-being in Taiwanese study

candidates.summary: Among more than 1,300 Taiwanese adolescents living in poverty, those facing more material hardship reported poorer family relationships and more psychological distress. Family ties appeared to be the most consistent link between deprivation and adolescents’ well-being.
